clock_definitions.solver_seconds: Inside the child, immediately before invoking the selected solver through CUDA synchronization, download, teardown and model release. The spatial verification fingerprint is outside this clock.
clock_definitions.fresh_process_return_seconds: In the coordinator, immediately before Popen through receipt of the flushed RETURN marker. Includes interpreter, imports, exact-identity handshake, solver and spatial fingerprint. Excludes subsequent NPZ serialization, exit and scoring. Driver and OS caches remain in place.

implementation_scope: Formal replays use exactly 19 common physical observations and the full probe histories. Independently archived switched qualification covers two additional immediately post-bridge observations.
selection_scope: One sequential fresh-process cohort per scale. Any failure stays in the registered slot. Contaminated or incomplete cohorts provide diagnostic comparisons only.
